title: AIDesigner MCP clones site HTML and CSS into Claude Code projects
summary: Spanish promo of a Claude Code demo using AIDesigner MCP to analyze page HTML/CSS and clone or inspire layouts from live URLs such as browserbase.com and linear.app; hosted MCP at api.aidesigner.ai with npm bootstrap @aidesigner/agent-skills.
question_it_answers: How does AIDesigner MCP let Claude Code clone or inspire UI from an existing website URL?

claims.text: AIDesigner MCP analyzes HTML and CSS of any page and extracts colors, typography, and components for Claude Code.
claims.evidence: Montó un MCP que analiza el HTML/CSS de cualquier página y extrae colores, tipografía y componentes.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: The hosted MCP endpoint is https://api.aidesigner.ai/api/v1/mcp with npm bootstrap @aidesigner/agent-skills.
